alignment.native_field_binding: Every official development request receipt must expose the named field with the exact explicit generated_frame_index and target_physical_time_s rows
alignment.clock_bridge: elapsed physical seconds from request current original-camera capture
prohibited_inferences: generated frame number as action number
presentation video FPS as target timing
concatenated presentation video frame position as physical time
alignment.primary_horizon_rule: longest strictly positive native-time-qualified target inside the unchanged executed prefix
alignment.early_horizon_rule: earliest strictly positive native-time-qualified target below the primary horizon
alignment.timestamp_tolerance_rule: min(half minimum positive native control interval, half minimum positive original-camera capture interval)

sampling.algorithm: Within each episode, sort eligible source_request_id values by SHA256(UTF8(seed) || NUL || UTF8(episode_id) || NUL || UTF8(source_request_id)), breaking digest ties by source_request_id; select the first min(4, eligible_count).
sampling.selection_timing: after complete request inventory and before labels

annotation_release_gate.movement_resolution_source: 95th percentile of duplicate development label disagreement in relative image coordinates

claim_boundary: A passed release receipt authorizes only the frozen confirmation cohort; it is not a model episode, annotation result, forecast-accuracy result, or evidence that an unresolved model qualified.
